writings.title: When AI learns from its own reflection.
writings.originalTitle: Feedback Loop Collapse of Artificial Intelligence
writings.description: What happens when artificial intelligence is increasingly trained on its own output? An exploration of recursive training, diversity loss, and Corpus Entropy Decay.
paragraphs: A model learns from a body of information. But as more of that information is produced by other models, the relationship between the learner and the world becomes less direct. The training corpus begins to reflect previous predictions.

This technical note examines feedback loop collapse: the effects of repeatedly training models on synthetic outputs. It introduces Corpus Entropy Decay as a way to describe degradation in diversity, correctness, creativity, and robustness across recursive training cycles.
The full note, published on Zenodo on 14 March 2026, sets out the proposed framework. Read the source for its definitions, reasoning, and limitations.

insights.title: Make room for the idea.
insights.text: A page can say more when it tries to say less.
paragraphs: A crowded screen asks the reader to make all the decisions. A considered layout makes a few of those decisions for them: what matters, what belongs together, and where to go next.
White space is not a pause in the design. It is part of the sentence. It gives an image its scale, a line its emphasis, and an idea enough room to land.
The useful question is not whether another element can be added. It is whether the page becomes clearer when it is.

insights.title: Motion needs a reason.
insights.text: The best animation tells you something about the interface.
paragraphs: A transition can explain a relationship. A small response can confirm an action. A change in scale can move attention from an overview to a detail.
When everything moves with equal urgency, nothing has emphasis. Motion works best when it has a hierarchy, just like typography.
For this portfolio, the aim is to make movement feel like a consequence of exploration: scroll, point, select, and the page responds.

insights.title: Stay with the question.
insights.text: An explanation should survive a second reading.
paragraphs: An interesting claim invites attention. A useful explanation earns it by showing how the claim was reached.
Writing is a way to test an idea. Assumptions become visible when they have to fit inside a sentence, and a missing connection is harder to ignore on the page.
The aim is not certainty at any cost. It is clarity about what is known, what is inferred, and what still needs a better question.
